title: Fun Action Songs
text:
Action songs are fun songs for children. Children sing and move their bodies at the same time. For example, they clap their hands and jump. The songs are short and easy to learn.

One popular action song is Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes. In this song, children touch each body part. They sing the words and touch their head, shoulders, knees and toes. Everyone laughs and has fun.

questions.text: What do children do at the same time when they sing action songs?
options: They sing and move their bodies

questions.text: What do children touch in the song Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes?
Why are action songs good for young children?
options: They are fun and easy to learn

questions.text: How do the children probably feel at the end of the song?

vocabulary.definition: to hit your hands together to make a sound
to move up quickly from the ground
to put your hand on something
not difficult to do or understand

paragraph_translations: Las canciones de acción son canciones divertidas para niños. Los niños cantan y mueven el cuerpo al mismo tiempo. Por ejemplo, aplauden con las manos y saltan. Las canciones son cortas y fáciles de aprender.

Una canción de acción muy popular es Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes. En esta canción, los niños tocan cada parte del cuerpo. Cantan las palabras y tocan la cabeza, los hombros, las rodillas y los dedos de los pies. Todos se ríen y se divierten.
